description: This file defines a JUnit 5 extension class 'WithSystemPropertyExtension' used for setting and restoring system properties during test execution, based on annotations on test methods.

classes.name: WithSystemPropertyExtension
classes.description: JUnit 5 extension class for managing system properties during test execution.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets system properties before each test if annotations are present.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Restores original system properties after each test.

methods.name: overrideSystemPropertyValue
methods.description: Sets or clears a system property based on provided value.

methods.name: saveOriginalSystemPropertyValue
methods.description: Stores the original system property value in the extension context store.

methods.name: loadOriginalSystemPropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves the original system property value from the store.

methods.name: hasAnnotation
methods.description: Checks if the test method has the 'WithSystemProperty' annotation.
